_doc: ErAV opening story event (plan 2.1, expanded). Trigger: None — started manually by campaign init (EventHandler.StartEvent). Targets 'kanon' (Kiryu Kanon) and 'kanade' (Miyama Kanade) must be injected into EventInstance.Targets by the caller (C# side) before this event runs; this file declares NO TargetGeneration/TargetValidators. portraitRefKey: 'kanon'/'kanade' for their portraits, 'self' for the player, '' for plain narration. AVG-style: each spoken line is its own entry. Kanon explains the joint-guarantor debt in character (mechanism -> amount -> work-hours math -> bankruptcy/seizure), then offers (softly, NOT framed as a standalone 'take over the firm' mechanic) to introduce quick-money work — she has channels to sell filmed work, the player handles shooting, hinting at Kanade's involvement, and adds that she can also supply OTHER actresses for an introduction fee — while stressing honest labor cannot fill the hole. Question 1 (agree/refuse her help): she leaves her contact card regardless. Agree -> she awaits at her office, expects presentable footage within days; Refuse -> she states the month-end interest due and that she'll be at her office to 'help'. In the Agree branch, after Kanon leaves Kanade volunteers -> Question 2 (accept/refuse Kanade's involvement): Accept -> go forward together; Refuse -> ends in the same somber 'carry it alone' key as refusing Kanon. Both close with a transition to the next morning (gameplay begins). State-writing (campaign_state / debt activation) is intentionally NOT done here — handled C#-side per plan 2.2/7.x. zh-cn is gender-neutral and contains no CJK U+4E00.

zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L01: 双亲的葬礼，在淅淅沥沥的雨里办完了。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L02: 灵车远去，$self.name$牵着妹妹$kanade.name$的手，回到那栋再不会有人迎接他们的房子。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L03: 推开门，屋里冷清得像结了霜。遗像前的线香，还冒着细细的青烟。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L04: $kanade.name$才十五岁。校服上别着的黑纱，衬得她脸色愈发苍白。她哭得没了力气，却始终不肯松开$self.name$的衣角。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L05: 「……$self.name$，从今往后，就只剩我们两个了。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L07: $self.name$把妹妹揽进怀里，却半句安慰的话也说不出口——自己心里，同样是空荡荡的。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L08: 就在这时，门外忽然响起毫不客气的叩门声。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L09: $self.name$刚拉开门，三个剃着光头的黑衣男人，已立在廊下。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L10: 当中那位身着华美和服的少女，撑着纸伞，抬眼打量着屋内。雨珠顺着伞骨，滑落下来。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L12: 「桐生歌音。桐生组的女儿，也是你们学校的学生会长。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L13: 「本小姐今夜登门，不为别的，只为令尊留下的那笔账。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L15: 「简单说：连带保证。令尊宫间谦三，替人作了保。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L16: 「如今那个主债务人，查无此人——按约，账就落到保证人头上。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L17: 「令尊令堂皆已过世。作为继承人，这笔债，自然转到你和令妹肩上。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L20: 「利息按月滚算，只增不减。单是利息，每月就要四十五万。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L21: 「别想着赖账——连带保证的债，连破产都洗不掉。桐生组有的是办法：查封房产、扣押账户、断了你的生路。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L23: $self.name$脑子里嗡嗡作响。父亲生前从不提钱的事，原来竟埋下了这么大的雷。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L24: $kanon.name$的话像铁锤，砸得两人喘不过气。$kanade.name$攥紧了$self.name$的衣袖，指节泛白。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L26: 「哭也没用。本小姐把账算给你听：那笔利息，换算成打工，就是四百多个钟头。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L27: 「把自己累垮，每月也熬不出这么多工时，更遑论那三千万的本金。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L28: 「——靠正经路子，你们这辈子的光阴，都填不满这个窟窿。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L30: 「本小姐倒有门路，能介绍些来钱快的活计。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L31: 「桐生组底下，有条贩卖影像的门路。拍什么、怎么拍，由你们自己张罗。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L32: 「拍出来，销路由本小姐打理。赚到的钱，足够你们填债。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L33: $kanon.name$的目光，意味深长地掠过躲在$self.name$身后的$kanade.name$。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L34: 「这孩子，生得倒标致。有这么个帮手，想必不愁拍不出东西。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L35: 「自然，用不用令妹，由你定。若需要别的女优人选，本小姐这里也有——介绍出去，收中介费。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_L36: 「怎么样？要不要本小姐，帮你们这个忙？」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_Q01: $kanon.name$从袖中取出名片，搁在桌上，抬眼望向$self.name$。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A02: 「桐生组的事务所，本小姐在那儿等你。地址，名片上写着。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A03: 「几天之内，带上拿得出手的成片，来见本小姐。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A04: 话音落下，$kanon.name$拢了拢和服领口，转身朝门外走去。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A05: 黑衣男人鱼贯跟上。临到门口，她忽又停下，背对着屋里。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A06: 「……对于你父母的事，本小姐很遗憾。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A07: 门合上的瞬间，屋里只剩雨声，和线香燃尽的轻响。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A09: $kanade.name$抬起通红的眼睛，望着$self.name$，半晌，才小声开口。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_A10: 「……你既然应下了那桩事，那、那我也想帮忙。我虽笨手笨脚，可只要能帮上你，什么都肯学。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_AQ: $kanade.name$眼里满是期待，又藏着几分忐忑，等着$self.name$的回答。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_AC03: $self.name$轻轻揉了揉妹妹的头。窗外，雨势渐歇。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_AC04: 那夜，两人谁也没合眼，可心里，却多了些暖意。等窗棂透进微白的晨光，雨已经停了。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_AC05: 天亮了。摆在$self.name$面前的，是三千万的债——可至少，身边还有$kanade.name$相伴。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_RC03: $kanade.name$的眼眶又红了。她张了张嘴，终究没再坚持，只是默默攥紧了衣角。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_RC04: $self.name$把妹妹搂进怀里。窗外的雨势渐歇，可沉甸甸压在心头的，并不只是债务。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_RC05: 那夜，两人谁也没合眼。等窗棂透进微白的晨光，雨已经停了。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_RC06: 天亮了。哪怕应下了桐生组的门路，这条路，$self.name$也只能独自走。摆在面前的，是三千万，和必须扛起的重担。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R02: 「随你。只是记好——月底之前，四十五万的利息，分文不能少。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R03: 「到了日子交不上，桐生组自有收账的法子。到时候，可别怪本小姐不讲情面。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R04: 「哪天撑不住了，来事务所找本小姐。这扇门，始终为你开着。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R05: 话音落下，$kanon.name$拢了拢和服领口，转身朝门外走去。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R06: 黑衣男人鱼贯跟上。临到门口，她忽又停下，背对着屋里。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R07: 「……对于你父母的事，本小姐很遗憾。」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R08: 门合上的瞬间，屋里只剩雨声，和线香燃尽的轻响。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R10: $kanade.name$嘴唇抖了抖，半晌，才挤出几个字。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R11: 「四十五万……月底之前……我们、我们去哪儿弄这么多钱？」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R12: 「打工……就算不眠不休，也……也填不上这个窟窿啊……」
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R14: $self.name$把妹妹搂进怀里。窗外，雨势渐歇，两人却都明白，前路凶险。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R15: 那夜，两人谁也没合眼。等窗棂透进微白的晨光，雨已经停了。
zh-cn.event_OpeningErAV_R16: 天亮了。摆在$self.name$面前的，是三千万的债，和必须独自扛起的重担。

en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L01: The funeral of your parents is over, done in a thin, ceaseless rain.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L02: As the hearse recedes, $self.name$ holds the hand of $kanade.name$ — your little sister — and walks back to a house where no one will ever welcome you home again.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L03: The door opens onto a chill like frost. Before the portrait, the incense still trails its thin blue smoke.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L04: $kanade.name$ is only fifteen. The black sash pinned to her uniform makes her face look paler still; she has cried herself past all strength, yet will not let go of $self.name$'s hem.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L05: …$self.name$… from now on, it's only the two of us.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L06: Mm… I'm still here. Don't be afraid.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L07: $self.name$ draws the girl into an embrace, yet not a word of comfort will come — inside, your own chest is just as hollow.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L08: Just then, a peremptory knock falls on the door.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L09: The instant $self.name$ opens it, three bald men in black suits already stand on the step.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L10: Between them, a girl in an embroidered kimono lifts a paper umbrella and lets her gaze sweep the room. Rain slides down the ribs of the umbrella.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L12: Kiryu Kanon. The Kiryu-gumi's daughter — and the student council president at your school.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L13: I've come tonight for only one matter: the debt your father left behind.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L15: Simply put: a joint-guarantor bond. Your father, Miyama Kenzou, stood guarantor for someone.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L16: That principal debtor is now nowhere to be found — and by the bond's terms, the debt falls on the guarantor.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L17: With both your parents gone, as their heirs, it passes to you and your sister.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L18: Joint guarantor… Father… how could he…
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L20: Interest compounds monthly, and only climbs. Interest alone runs four hundred and fifty thousand a month.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L21: Don't bother trying to walk away — a guarantor's debt survives even bankruptcy. The Kiryu-gumi has its ways: seize the house, freeze the accounts, cut off your livelihood.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L22: Thirty million… four hundred and fifty thousand…
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L23: The words buzz hollow in $self.name$'s skull. Father never spoke of money — to think he'd buried a snare this large.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L24: Each of $kanon.name$'s words lands like a hammer, driving the breath from them both. $kanade.name$ grips $self.name$'s sleeve until her knuckles go white.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L25: $self.name$… thirty million… can we truly ever repay it?
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L26: Tears won't help. Let me do the math for you: that interest, in working hours, comes to over four hundred hours.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L27: You could work yourself into the ground and still not earn that many hours a month — to say nothing of the thirty-million principal.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L28: —By honest labor alone, you'd spend your whole lives and never fill this hole.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L29: However… if you truly have nowhere else to turn—
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L30: —I happen to have connections. I can introduce you to work that pays fast.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L31: Under the Kiryu-gumi there's a channel for selling filmed work. What to shoot, how to shoot it — that's for you to arrange.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L32: Once it's shot, the distribution is my affair. What you'd earn is more than enough to pay down the debt.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L33: $kanon.name$'s gaze drifts, meaning-laden, past $self.name$ to $kanade.name$ hiding behind.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L34: The child is rather pretty. With a helper like her, you'd have no trouble producing something.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L35: Naturally, whether you use your sister or not is your call. If you'd rather have other actresses, I can provide them too — for an introduction fee.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_L36: Well? Would you like my help with this?
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_Q01: $kanon.name$ draws a business card from her sleeve, sets it on the table, and lifts her eyes to $self.name$.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A02: The Kiryu-gumi's office — I'll be waiting for you there. The address is on the card.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A03: Within a few days, bring me footage worth watching. Come see me.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A04: With that, $kanon.name$ smooths the collar of her kimono and turns toward the door.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A05: The men in black file after her. At the threshold she pauses, her back to the room.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A07: As the door clicks shut, only the rain remains, and the faint sound of the incense burning down.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A09: $kanade.name$ lifts red-rimmed eyes to $self.name$; after a long moment, she speaks, softly.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_A10: …Since you've taken on this work, then… then I want to help too. I may be clumsy, but if it helps you, I'll learn anything.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_AQ: $kanade.name$'s eyes are full of hope, threaded with unease, waiting for $self.name$'s answer.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_AC01: …All right. Then… I'm counting on you.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_AC03: $self.name$ gently ruffles the girl's hair. Outside, the rain begins to ease.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_AC04: That night, neither of them sleeps — yet somewhere in their chests, a faint warmth takes hold. By the time a pale dawn seeps through the window, the rain has stopped.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_AC05: Morning has come. Before $self.name$ lies a thirty-million debt — but at least $kanade.name$ is at your side.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_RC01: …Stay out of this. I'll handle it myself.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_RC03: $kanade.name$'s eyes redden again. She opens her mouth, then says nothing more, only gripping her hem in silence.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_RC04: $self.name$ draws the girl close. Outside, the rain is easing — yet what weighs heavy on the heart is more than the debt alone.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_RC05: That night, neither of them sleeps. By the time a pale dawn seeps through the window, the rain has stopped.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_RC06: Morning has come. The Kiryu-gumi's road is taken, yet this path $self.name$ must walk alone. Before you lie thirty million, and a burden to be carried by yourself.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R01: Oh? You'd rather shoulder it alone?
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R02: As you wish. Only remember — by month's end, the four hundred and fifty thousand in interest, not a yen less.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R03: Miss that day, and the Kiryu-gumi has its own ways of collecting. Don't say I showed you no courtesy.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R04: When it gets to be too much, come find me at the office. That door stays open for you.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R05: With that, $kanon.name$ smooths the collar of her kimono and turns toward the door.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R06: The men in black file after her. At the threshold she pauses, her back to the room.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R08: As the door clicks shut, only the rain remains, and the faint sound of the incense burning down.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R10: $kanade.name$'s lips tremble; it is a long moment before she forces out a few words.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R11: Four hundred and fifty thousand… by month's end… where… where are we supposed to get that much?
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R12: Part-time work… even without sleep, it… it still wouldn't fill this hole…
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R13: …Leave it to me. I'll think of something.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R14: $self.name$ draws the girl close. Outside, the rain begins to ease — yet both of them know the road ahead is steep and dark.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R15: That night, neither of them sleeps. By the time a pale dawn seeps through the window, the rain has stopped.
en-us.event_OpeningErAV_R16: Morning has come. Before $self.name$ lies a thirty-million debt — and a burden that must now be carried alone.
